title: Spoiled-ballot opening version 3: openings of ballot version 4's cores, both halves
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/spoiled-opening-v3-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/challenge.md (Opening version 3) with Python's integers and hashlib, reusing share-encryption-v4-vectors.py's version-4 ciphertexts over share-encryption-vectors.py's self-checked ML-KEM-768, ChaCha20-Poly1305 and ristretto255, ballot-v4-vectors.py's core hash and the version-6 definition generator; nothing from packages/crypto. The randomness is SHA-512 of fixed labels: test data only.
